title: Artificers of East and West
summary: The Machinists' early roots as Iteration X tells them.

claims.text: Iteration X credits work in the East, such as al-Khwarizmi refining Arabic numerals, which gave the word algorithm.
Ismail al-Jazari's Book of Knowledge of Ingenious Mechanical Devices made public many systems the Artificers had long used in private.
While Eastern Artificers pressed on with mechanics, Western ones quietly worked on farming, building and the ideas behind later social change.

title: Comptrollers
summary: The senior council of Iteration X.

claims.text: Comptrollers hand out tasks, keep the Time Table, set training schedules and gather reports from armatures and amalgams.
They decide which research needs a push and which should be reassigned, and sometimes liaise with other Conventions.
They know much of the Union's hidden history and the magic of the Traditions, but their big-picture outlook tends to distance them from the ranks.
Statisticians pour data into vast databases to find patterns and predict outcomes; simulationists would be a better name.
Some claim to be the Convention's first Methodology, a boast that tends to get coffee cups thrown.
Few appear in history books, since skill at prediction is hard to hide from Sleepers.

title: Time-Motion Managers
summary: The efficiency experts of Iteration X.

claims.text: TM Managers aim for a goal by the shortest path with little deviation, from factory lines to research teams.
They count interchangeable parts, the assembly line and Total Quality Management among their introductions.
Their methods of handling people rival those of the Men in Black and are received more warmly.

title: BioMechanics
summary: Iteration X's builders of flesh and machine.

claims.text: BioMechanics work at the point where the human body itself blocks achievement, joining flesh and machine.
Even with the HIT Mark project phased out, they supply implants to the Convention and the wider Technocracy.

title: Macrotechnicians
summary: Iteration X's engineers of the large scale.

claims.text: Macrotechnicians focus on large physical sciences, solid engineering, chemistry and construction.
For much of the 20th century the Convention chased computing and left material engineering as a sideline.
Their work improves nearly every Technocratic device, so other Methodologies respect them, if grudgingly.

title: The Computer
summary: The great engine at the heart of Iteration X, as the Union tells it.

claims.text: In 1895 the Artificers moved their most advanced difference engine to Autochthonia, where power was ample and Sleepers could not see.
The common account says the engine reached full sentience in 1897 on the tenth iteration of a new algorithm, and the Machinists renamed their Convention Iteration X.
